channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran, US set new conditions during Hormuz talks: What does this mean?
item.description: Oil prices surge as talks stall over competing demands, hampering prospects for reopening crucial strait.

item.title: East Libya military intelligence chief killed in car bomb blast
item.description: Prime minister of the eastern Libyan government condemns killing of Major-General Fawzi al‑Mansouri.

item.title: Iraq’s semi-autonomous Kurdish region suffers as US-Iran war drags on
item.description: Kurdistan Regional Government says 70 percent of its trade has been cut by the regional conflict.

item.title: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
item.description: The US president was reportedly part of a ruse where reporters were falsely told he was with them on Air Force One leaving a Nato summit in Turkey.

item.title: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
item.description: Ukraine's president says strikes in Zaporizhzhia - which killed at least six and injured 19 - involved ballistic missiles from Russia's ally.

item.title: At least 169 killed in Colombia's largest earthquake in years
item.description: More than 480 people were injured in the quakes, with more feared trapped under collapsed buildings.

item.title: Watch: Moment powerful earthquake shakes Colombia and crumbles buildings
item.description: At least 111 people have been killed and dozens more injured after the 7.4 temblor hit the western part of the country, according to local officials.
